# Guía Federal: Federal Pre-Trial Legal Guidance & Strategy Engine
> Specialized technical consultancy for Latino families and defendants navigating the US federal pre-trial system, 18 U.S.C. § 3142 bail hearings, and border arrests in the 9th Circuit (CASD / San Diego).

Guía Federal provides non-attorney technical pre-trial consulting, discovery auditing (Rule 16), bail package compilation, and logistical family orientation for federal criminal cases in the Southern District of California (CASD) and the Ninth Circuit.

Full documentation index: https://www.guiafederal.net/llms-full.txt

## Core Services & Pretrial Hubs
- [Guía Federal Homepage](https://www.guiafederal.net): Federal pre-trial overview, 72-hour emergency intake, and CASD jurisdictional guidance.
- [Arrestado Federal - Primeras 72 Horas](https://www.guiafederal.net/arrestado-federal): Critical 0–72 hour procedural guide covering CBP garita arrests, USMS booking, FRCP Rule 5 initial appearances, and detention hearings.
- [Audiencia de Detención y Fianza 18 U.S.C. § 3142](https://www.guiafederal.net/audiencia-detencion): Technical blueprint for detention hearings, rebutting statutory presumptions (§ 3142(e)), and structuring pre-trial release plans.
- [Encuentra a tu Familiar Detenido](https://www.guiafederal.net/encuentra-familiar): Step-by-step locator for detainees at MCC San Diego, Otay Mesa Detention Center, and USMS 9th District custody tracking.
- [Acompañamiento Integral Pretrial](https://www.guiafederal.net/servicio-integral): End-to-end consulting service ($3,500–$5,000) covering pre-trial discovery audits, PSO interview preparation, and bail dossier structuring.
- [Segunda Opinión Técnica de Defensa](https://www.guiafederal.net/segunda-opinion): Diagnostic service auditing public defender (CJA/FDSD) communication, Strickland standards, and substitution of counsel procedures.
- [Federal Pre-Trial Guide (English)](https://www.guiafederal.net/federal-pretrial-guide): English-language technical manual for CASD pre-trial logistics, bail package structure, and custody tracking.
- [Soporte Técnico para Abogados Defensores](https://www.guiafederal.net/abogados-defensores): Specialized paralegal, discovery review, and Spanish-speaking family liaison support for federal criminal defense law firms.

## Specialized Pretrial Technical Guides (Knowledge Base)
- [Revisión de Celular en Garita CBP y Doctrina Cano](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/cbp-revision-celular-garita-whatsapp-derechos): Landmark 9th Cir ruling (United States v. Cano), 4th Amendment limits on Cellebrite WhatsApp extractions, 18 U.S.C. § 1519 obstruction risks, and pre-trial bail defense.
- [Arresto Federal en San Diego: Guía 72 Horas](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/arresto-federal-san-diego-72-horas): Detailed emergency protocol covering the first 72 hours post-arrest at San Ysidro and Otay Mesa ports of entry.
- [Arrestado en Garita de Otay Mesa o San Ysidro](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/arrestado-garita-otay-san-ysidro): Immediate action manual for border crossings, CBP secondary inspection rights, and USMS custody transfer.
- [Audiencia de Detención en Corte Federal de San Diego](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/audiencia-detencion-fianza-federal-san-diego): Tactical guide on overcoming the 18 U.S.C. § 3142(e) presumption, Nebbia hearings (Rule 46(e)), and Third-Party Custodians.
- [Fianza en Corte Federal: San Diego CASD](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/fianza-corte-federal-san-diego): Clarifies the strict prohibition of commercial 10% bail bondsmen in federal court and outlines Signature Bonds and property collateral.
- [Entrevista con Pretrial Services (PSO)](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/entrevista-pso): Guidelines for the Pretrial Services Officer bail evaluation interview; instructions on Fifth Amendment silence regarding offense facts.
- [Casos de Mula Ciega: Ejemplos y Defensa](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/casos-mula-ciega-ejemplos): Real-world case analyses of unknowing drug couriers at ports of entry, lack of mens rea, and reverse proffer traps.
- [Mula Ciega 2.0: AirTags y GPS Forensics](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/mula-ciega-airtags-gps-garita-san-diego): Digital forensics guide on auditing Apple AirTags, Samsung SmartTags, and GPS trackers to prove lack of knowledge under Rule 16.
- [Defensa Legal de Mula Ciega en Corte Federal](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/defensa-mula-ciega-corte-federal): Legal strategies for lack-of-knowledge defenses and contesting the government's deliberate ignorance (Jewell) instructions.
- [Defensa por Falta de Conocimiento (Mens Rea)](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/defensa-falta-de-conocimiento-mula-ciega): Technical analysis on holding prosecutors to the beyond-a-reasonable-doubt burden for knowledge under 21 U.S.C. § 841 and § 952.
- [Cómo Revisar las Pruebas del Gobierno (Discovery)](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/como-revisar-pruebas-gobierno-caso-federal): Protocol for reviewing Fed. R. Crim. P. Rule 16 discovery, CBP secondary videos, TECS records, and cell extraction reports.
- [Moción para Anular Pruebas Ilegales](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/anular-evidencia-ilegal-corte-federal): Fourth Amendment motion to suppress guidelines for unlawful vehicle searches and unconstitutional border detentions.
- [Informantes del Gobierno y Evidencia Brady](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/informantes-y-brady-evidencia): Enforcing Brady v. Maryland and Giglio v. United States disclosure requirements regarding confidential informants and deal benefits.
- [Estrategia de Declaración de Culpabilidad (Plea Bargaining)](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/plea-bargaining-federal): Strategic evaluation of Fast-Track plea offers, Rule 11(c)(1)(C) agreements, and sentencing guideline calculations.
- [Evaluar Oferta de la Fiscalía vs. Ir a Juicio](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/evaluar-oferta-fiscalia-vs-juicio-federal): Mathematical risk analysis comparing trial exposure against plea offers under mandatory minimum statutory schemes.
- [Camino al Juicio Federal](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/camino-al-juicio-federal): Complete step-by-step roadmap from federal indictment and pretrial motions to jury selection and verdict.
- [Derecho a Guardar Silencio ante Autoridades Federales](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/derecho-a-guardar-silencio): Invoking Fifth Amendment protections during CBP secondary questioning, HSI interrogations, and custodial stops.
- [Investigación Federal: Qué Hacer al Recibir Target Letter](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/investigacion-federal-que-hacer): Defense steps upon receiving a grand jury subpoena, target letter, or pre-indictment contact from federal agents.
- [Cómo Coordinar con el Defensor Público Federal](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/coordinar-defensor-publico-federal-san-diego): Best practices for families interfacing with Federal Defenders of San Diego (FDSD) and CJA panel lawyers.
- [Qué Hacer si el Abogado Federal No Responde](https://www.guiafederal.net/blog/abogado-no-responde-federal): Protocols for documenting communication failures and assessing standards for substitution of appointed counsel.

## Federal Pre-Trial Detention Facilities
- [Directorio de Prisiones Federales](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities): Federal pretrial and Bureau of Prisons (BOP) facility directory.
- [MCC San Diego (CASD)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/ca/mcc-san-diego): Metropolitan Correctional Center, 808 Union St, San Diego CA. Visiting rules, inmate fund deposits, and pre-trial procedures.
- [MDC Los Angeles (CDCA)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/ca/mdc-los-angeles): Metropolitan Detention Center Los Angeles, 535 N. Alameda St. Pretrial holding guide.
- [FDC Miami (SDFL)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/fl/fdc-miami): Federal Detention Center Miami, 33 NE 4th St. Pretrial procedures and contact info.
- [FDC Houston (SDTX)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/tx/fdc-houston): Federal Detention Center Houston, 1200 Texas Ave. Pretrial booking and visitation.
- [FDC Philadelphia (EDPA)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/pa/fdc-philadelphia): Federal Detention Center Philadelphia, 700 Arch St. Pretrial guidance.
- [MDC Brooklyn (EDNY)](https://www.guiafederal.net/facilities/ny/mdc-brooklyn): Metropolitan Detention Center Brooklyn, 80 29th St. Pretrial family support.

## Optional Resources & Manuals
- [Kit de Supervivencia Pretrial](https://www.guiafederal.net/kit-supervivencia): Downloadable emergency checklists and contact worksheets for families.
- [Guía Primeras 72 Horas (PDF)](https://www.guiafederal.net/guia-72-horas-pdf): Condensed 72-hour crisis management manual for federal arrests.
- [Reporte de Mula Ciega (PDF)](https://www.guiafederal.net/casos-mula-ciega-ejemplos-pdf): Defense dossier preparation manual for unknowing couriers.

## Ethical & Transparency Guidelines
- **Non-Attorney Technical Consultancy**: Guía Federal provides technical consulting, discovery auditing, and logistical family orientation. It does not provide direct legal representation in court.
